# Sentopi

> Sentopi is a review intelligence platform for Amazon brands. It reads every review, maps each complaint to a root cause (listing accuracy, product, or operations), and delivers a priority-scored fix list with estimated revenue impact.

Sentopi turns Amazon customer reviews into a ranked action plan: which issues to fix first, who should own them, and what each fix is worth in annual revenue. The differentiator is financial context: every insight is tied to a revenue impact estimate rather than a bare sentiment score.

## Key facts

- What it is: review intelligence for Amazon brands that maps each complaint to a root cause (listing accuracy, product, or operations) and ranks fixes by estimated revenue impact.
- Differentiator: financial context. Every issue is tied to a dollar impact estimate rather than a bare sentiment score.
- Original research finding: across 3,725 Amazon reviews spanning 7 brands in 4 categories, 40 to 55 percent of 1-star reviews trace to listing accuracy problems rather than product failures.
- Free tools: the Revenue Risk Report gives an instant per-ASIN revenue-risk read with no email required; the first product analysis is free.
- Pricing: ongoing monitoring is $149 per month per product. The service is done for you: Sentopi gathers, reads, and scores everything, so there is no dashboard to operate.
- Framework: the Retail Flywheel. Five levers run every Amazon brand (Operations, Pricing, Assortment, Visibility, Ratings); Ratings is the feedback signal that reports on the other four, and it is the lever Sentopi runs for its customers.
- Founders: Oliver Silen and An Luong, with 10+ years in retail and ecommerce at companies including Amazon and Walmart.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://sentopi.com/): What Sentopi does and how to get a free analysis for your first product.
- [Revenue Risk Report](https://sentopi.com/revenue-risk-report): Free instant tool. Paste an ASIN or Seller ID to see where a brand is losing revenue across Best Seller Rank, rating trajectory, and Buy Box, with an estimated dollar impact.
- [Star Rating Calculator](https://sentopi.com/star-rating-calculator): Free calculator. Enter rating, review count, and revenue to see how many 5-star reviews reach a target rating and the conversion and revenue lift on the way there.
- [Listing Accuracy Research](https://sentopi.com/listing-accuracy): Original study of 3,725 Amazon reviews across 7 brands in 4 categories, finding that 40-55% of 1-star reviews trace to listing accuracy problems rather than product failures.
- [The Growth Loop](https://sentopi.com/growth-loop): Framework article. The five levers every Amazon brand runs on (Operations, Pricing, Assortment, Visibility, Ratings), run as a weekly loop, with benchmarks for each lever and a sales-drop diagnostic.
- [Why Are My Amazon Sales Down](https://sentopi.com/why-are-my-amazon-sales-down): Five-minute diagnostic for a sudden Amazon sales drop: the sessions-versus-conversion fork, then the five most common causes with what to check for each.
- [Guides hub](https://sentopi.com/guides): Index of all Sentopi guides and research for Amazon brands.
